title: Break your trailer into short, time-coded scenes (e.g., 3–12s each) and…
content:
Break your trailer into short, time-coded scenes (e.g., 3–12s each) and generate each scene separately in Seedance 2.0, then assemble the full trailer in CapCut.

For each Seedance scene prompt, explicitly specify Visual Elements, Lighting & Atmosphere, and Camera Movement to control environment design, mood, and shot behavior.

Use establishing-shot language like “slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down” to get epic world-building openers.

To depict a character transformation, prompt a clear action sequence (stand up → golden light particles swirl → outfit transforms into armored suit) and request “dynamic close-ups” during the change.

For action pacing, prompt “rapid cuts” between specific subjects (shield close-ups, facial expressions, movement beats) and include “dramatic slow-motion” for a hero moment.

To emphasize speed in a charge, prompt a “fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her” and add “cinematic depth of field” plus “glowing light bursts.”

For a powerful ending, prompt a “gentle push-in” that resolves into an “iconic final portrait frame,” and use a cross-fade to transition between forms (gown → armored warrior).

es.content:
Divide tu tráiler en escenas cortas con código de tiempo (por ejemplo, de 3 a 12 s cada una) y genera cada escena por separado en Seedance 2.0; luego ensambla el tráiler completo en CapCut.

Para cada prompt de escena en Seedance, especifica explícitamente Visual Elements, Lighting & Atmosphere y Camera Movement para controlar el diseño del entorno, el estado de ánimo y el comportamiento de la toma.

Usa lenguaje de establishing shot como “slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down” para conseguir aperturas épicas de world-building.

Para representar la transformación de un personaje, redacta una secuencia de acciones clara (stand up → golden light particles swirl → outfit transforms into armored suit) y solicita “dynamic close-ups” durante el cambio.

Para el ritmo de acción, usa “rapid cuts” entre sujetos específicos (shield close-ups, facial expressions, movement beats) e incluye “dramatic slow-motion” para un momento heroico.

Para enfatizar la velocidad en una carga, redacta un “fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her” y añade “cinematic depth of field” junto con “glowing light bursts.”

Para un final potente, redacta un “gentle push-in” que desemboque en un “iconic final portrait frame,” y usa un cross-fade para transicionar entre formas (gown → armored warrior).

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Thread 1] Scene 1: The Celestial City (00:00 – 00:03)
​Visual Elements: Una extensa y desbordante metrópolis de fantasía construida íntegramente en mármol blanco y arquitectura dorada, con altísimas agujas góticas, majestuosas catedrales y puentes con vistas a una tranquila bahía costera bajo un cielo brillante y nublado.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Luz diurna intensa, etérea, majestuosa, de gran escala, establishing shot épico de fantasía cinematográfica.
​Camera Movement: Slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down at the magnificent kingdom.
​Scene 2: The Throne Room Transformation (00:04 – 00:17)
​Visual Elements: Una vasta y ornamentada sala del trono en blanco y dorado, con enormes pilares, ventanas arqueadas de vidrieras y estandartes de seda ondeando. Una joven de largo cabello rubio, al principio vestida con un fluido vestido griego blanco, está sentada sobre un intrincado trono dorado de respaldo alto. Se pone de pie y partículas mágicas de luz dorada giran a su alrededor, transformando su atuendo en una elaborada armadura celestial de guerrera en blanco y dorado, completa con un escudo estampado y una espada ancha resplandeciente.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: God-rays volumétricos entrando por las altas ventanas, chispas mágicas doradas, grandeza de alta fantasía.
​Camera Movement: Static mid-shot tracking forward as she stands, shifting to dynamic close-ups of her armor transformation and heroic kneeling pose.
​Scene 3: Ready for Battle (00:18 – 00:30)
​Visual Elements: Primer plano del intrincado escudo con patrón de estrellas y de la expresión concentrada de la guerrera. Ella invoca un sello/círculo rúnico dorado brillante desde su escudo, avanza con confianza y ejecuta un salto dinámico desde una columna, aterrizando con gracia en una postura lista para la batalla.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Refracciones de luz dorada centelleante, intenso, heroico y sereno.
​Camera Movement: Rapid cuts between shield close-ups, facial expressions, and a dramatic slow-motion aerial spin.
​Scene 4: The Divine Charge (00:31 – 00:36)
​Visual Elements: La guerrera apunta su espada resplandeciente hacia delante y carga a través del pulido suelo de mármol. Ondas de choque mágicas doradas y anillos de luz irradian desde su escudo con cada movimiento.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Acción de alta energía, destellos de luz brillantes, cinematic depth of field.
​Camera Movement: Fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her charge, emphasizing speed and power.
​Scene 5: The Healer's Resurgence (00:37 – 00:49)
​Visual Elements: Regreso a la serena sala del trono, donde la mujer vuelve a sentarse en el trono con su vestido blanco. Toca el reposabrazos, lo que hace que energía mágica dorada y geometrías rúnicas flotantes se materialicen a su alrededor. El video culmina con un último cross-fade que muestra fugazmente su feroz forma de guerrera acorazada.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Resplandor suave, místico, divino y reflexivo que transiciona hacia un aura de poder absoluto.
​Camera Movement: Gentle push-in on the seated woman, ending with a powerful, iconic final portrait frame.

Pour chaque prompt de scène Seedance, spécifiez explicitement les Visual Elements, Lighting & Atmosphere, et Camera Movement afin de contrôler la conception de l’environnement, l’ambiance et le comportement du plan.

Utilisez un langage de establishing shot comme « slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down » pour obtenir des ouvertures épiques de world-building.

Pour le rythme des scènes d’action, demandez des « rapid cuts » entre des sujets précis (shield close-ups, facial expressions, movement beats) et incluez un « dramatic slow-motion » pour un moment héroïque.

Pour accentuer la vitesse lors d’une charge, demandez un « fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her » et ajoutez « cinematic depth of field » ainsi que « glowing light bursts ».

Pour une fin puissante, demandez un « gentle push-in » qui se conclut par un « iconic final portrait frame », et utilisez un cross-fade pour passer d’une forme à l’autre (gown → armored warrior).

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Scene 1: The Celestial City (00:00 – 00:03)
​Visual Elements: Une vaste métropole fantastique tentaculaire, entièrement construite en marbre blanc et en architecture dorée, avec de hautes flèches gothiques, de majestueuses cathédrales et des ponts surplombant une baie côtière paisible sous un ciel lumineux et nuageux.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Lumière du jour éclatante, éthérée, majestueuse, à grande échelle, establishing shot cinématographique de fantasy épique.
​Camera Movement: Slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down at the magnificent kingdom.
​Scene 2: The Throne Room Transformation (00:04 – 00:17)
​Visual Elements: Une vaste salle du trône blanche et dorée, richement ornée, avec d’immenses piliers, des fenêtres cintrées en vitrail et des bannières de soie flottantes. Une jeune femme aux longs cheveux blonds, portant d’abord une longue robe grecque blanche et fluide, est assise sur un trône doré complexe à haut dossier. Elle se lève, et des particules de lumière dorée magique tourbillonnent autour d’elle, transformant sa tenue en une armure guerrière céleste blanche et dorée, élaborée, avec un bouclier orné de motifs et une épée large lumineuse.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Rayons divins volumétriques traversant de hautes fenêtres, étincelles dorées magiques, grandeur de fantasy high-fantasy.
​Camera Movement: Static mid-shot tracking forward as she stands, shifting to dynamic close-ups of her armor transformation and heroic kneeling pose.
​Scene 3: Ready for Battle (00:18 – 00:30)
​Visual Elements: Gros plan sur le bouclier complexe à motif d’étoiles et sur l’expression concentrée de la guerrière. Elle invoque un sceau lumineux doré / cercle runique depuis son bouclier, avance avec assurance et exécute un saut dynamique depuis un pilier, atterrissant avec grâce dans une posture prête au combat.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Réfractions de lumière dorée scintillante, intense, héroïque et maîtrisée.
​Camera Movement: Rapid cuts between shield close-ups, facial expressions, and a dramatic slow-motion aerial spin.
​Scene 4: The Divine Charge (00:31 – 00:36)
​Visual Elements: La guerrière pointe son épée lumineuse vers l’avant et charge à travers le sol en marbre poli. Des ondes de choc magiques dorées et des anneaux de lumière rayonnent depuis son bouclier à chaque mouvement.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Action à haute énergie, glowing light bursts, cinematic depth of field.
​Camera Movement: Fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her charge, emphasizing speed and power.
​Scene 5: The Healer's Resurgence (00:37 – 00:49)
​Visual Elements: Retour dans la salle du trône sereine, où la femme se rassoit sur le trône dans sa robe blanche. Elle touche l’accoudoir, déclenchant l’apparition d’une énergie magique dorée et de géométries runiques flottantes autour d’elle. La vidéo se conclut par un dernier aperçu en cross-fade de sa forme de guerrière en armure, féroce.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Lueur douce, mystique, divine et réfléchie, se transformant en une aura de pouvoir absolu.
​Camera Movement: Gentle push-in on the seated woman, ending with a powerful, iconic final portrait frame.

ja.content:
トレーラーを短いタイムコード付きのシーンに分割し（例：各3〜12秒）、各シーンをSeedance 2.0で個別に生成したうえで、CapCutで全体のトレーラーを組み立てます。

各Seedanceシーンのpromptでは、環境デザイン、ムード、ショットの挙動をコントロールするために、Visual Elements、Lighting & Atmosphere、Camera Movementを明示的に指定してください。

「slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down」のような establishing-shot の表現を使うと、壮大な世界観を感じさせるオープニングを作れます。

キャラクターの変身を描く場合は、明確なアクションの流れ（stand up → golden light particles swirl → outfit transforms into armored suit）をpromptし、変化の最中に “dynamic close-ups” を指定してください。

アクションのテンポを出すには、特定の被写体（shield close-ups、facial expressions、movement beats）を切り替える “rapid cuts” をpromptし、ヒーローの見せ場には “dramatic slow-motion” を加えます。

突進のスピード感を強調するには、 “fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her” をpromptし、さらに “cinematic depth of field” と “glowing light bursts” を加えます。

力強いエンディングにするには、 “gentle push-in” から “iconic final portrait frame” に収束するようにpromptし、フォームの切り替え（gown → armored warrior）にはクロスフェードを使います。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Scene 1: The Celestial City (00:00 – 00:03)
​Visual Elements: 白い大理石と金の建築だけで構成された、広大でスケール感のあるファンタジー都市。そびえ立つゴシック様式の尖塔、荘厳な大聖堂、そして穏やかな海岸の湾を見下ろす橋があり、明るく雲のある空の下に広がっている。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 明るい昼光、幻想的、荘厳、壮大なスケール、cinematic な epic fantasy の establishing shot。
​Camera Movement: 壮麗な王国を見下ろす、ゆっくりとした大きく流れるような wide establishing shot。

​Scene 2: The Throne Room Transformation (00:04 – 00:17)
​Visual Elements: 巨大な柱、アーチ状のステンドグラス窓、流れるようなシルクのバナーを備えた、広大で装飾豊かな白と金の玉座の間。長い金髪の若い女性が、最初は流れるような白いギリシャ風のドレスを着て、精緻な高い背もたれの金の玉座に座っている。彼女が立ち上がると、魔法の金色の光の粒子が彼女の周囲を渦巻き、衣装が、模様入りの盾と輝く大剣を備えた、精巧で天上の白と金の鎧の戦士の装いへと変化する。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 高い窓から差し込む volumetric な god-rays、魔法の金色の火花、高ファンタジーの荘厳さ。
​Camera Movement: 彼女が立ち上がる間は静的な mid-shot tracking forward、そこから鎧の変身と英雄的なひざまずきのポーズに合わせて dynamic close-ups へ移行。

​Scene 3: Ready for Battle (00:18 – 00:30)
​Visual Elements: 精緻な星模様の盾と、戦士の集中した表情のクローズアップ。彼女は盾から輝く金色の紋章／ルーンの円を召喚し、自信を持って一歩踏み出し、柱からダイナミックに跳び降りて、戦闘態勢の美しい着地を決める。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: きらめく金色の光の屈折、強烈で、英雄的で、凛とした雰囲気。
​Camera Movement: 盾のクローズアップ、表情、そして dramatic slow-motion の空中スピンを rapid cuts で切り替える。

​Scene 4: The Divine Charge (00:31 – 00:36)
​Visual Elements: 戦士が輝く剣を前方に向け、磨き上げられた大理石の床を突進する。動くたびに、魔法の金色の衝撃波と光の輪が盾から放たれる。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: ハイエネルギーなアクション、光のバースト、cinematic depth of field。
​Camera Movement: 彼女の突進の前方を後退しながら追う fast tracking shot で、スピードと力強さを強調する。

​Scene 5: The Healer's Resurgence (00:37 – 00:49)
​Visual Elements: 静謐な玉座の間に戻り、女性は白いドレス姿で再び玉座に腰を下ろす。彼女が肘掛けに触れると、金色の魔法エネルギーと浮遊するルーンの幾何学模様が周囲に出現する。映像は、最後に彼女の勇ましい鎧の戦士の姿へと戻る cross-fade の一瞬で締めくくられる。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 柔らかく、神秘的で、神聖、内省的な光が、絶対的な力のオーラへと移り変わる。
​Camera Movement: 座る女性に gentle push-in し、最後は力強く象徴的な final portrait frame で終える。

ko.content:
트레일러를 3–12초 정도의 짧은 타임코드 장면들로 나누고, 각 장면을 Seedance 2.0에서 개별적으로 생성한 다음, CapCut에서 전체 트레일러를 편집해 하나로 합치세요.

각 Seedance 장면 prompt에서는 환경 디자인, 분위기, 샷의 움직임을 제어할 수 있도록 Visual Elements, Lighting & Atmosphere, Camera Movement를 명시적으로 지정하세요.

“slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down” 같은 establishing shot 표현을 사용해 장대한 세계관 오프닝을 만들어 보세요.

캐릭터 변신을 묘사할 때는 명확한 동작 시퀀스(stand up → golden light particles swirl → outfit transforms into armored suit)를 prompt하고, 변화 과정에서 “dynamic close-ups”를 요청하세요.

액션의 템포를 조절하려면 특정 대상들(방패 클로즈업, 표정, 움직임의 비트) 사이에 “rapid cuts”를 넣고, 영웅적인 순간에는 “dramatic slow-motion”을 포함하세요.

돌진의 속도를 강조하려면 “fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her”를 prompt하고, “cinematic depth of field”와 “glowing light bursts”를 추가하세요.

강렬한 엔딩을 위해서는 “gentle push-in”으로 시작해 “iconic final portrait frame”으로 마무리하고, 형태 전환(gown → armored warrior) 사이에는 cross-fade를 사용하세요.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Scene 1: The Celestial City (00:00 – 00:03)
​Visual Elements: 흰 대리석과 금빛 건축물로만 이루어진 광활하고 거대한 판타지 대도시로, 우뚝 솟은 고딕 첨탑, 장엄한 대성당, 그리고 맑고 흐린 하늘 아래 잔잔한 해안 만을 내려다보는 다리들이 특징이다.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 밝은 대낮, 초현실적이고 장엄하며, 웅장한 스케일의 cinematic epic fantasy establishing shot.
​Camera Movement: 장대한 왕국을 내려다보는 slow, sweeping wide establishing shot.
​Scene 2: The Throne Room Transformation (00:04 – 00:17)
​Visual Elements: 거대하고 화려한 흰색과 금색의 왕좌의 방. 거대한 기둥, 아치형 스테인드글라스 창문, 흐르는 듯한 실크 배너가 있다. 긴 금발의 젊은 여성은 처음에는 흐르는 흰색 그리스풍 드레스를 입고 정교한 높은 등받이의 황금 왕좌에 앉아 있다. 그녀가 일어서면 마법 같은 황금빛 입자들이 그녀를 감싸며 소용돌이치고, 의상은 무늬가 새겨진 방패와 빛나는 양손검을 갖춘 정교하고 천상적인 흰색과 금색의 갑옷 전사복으로 변한다.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 높은 창문을 통해 쏟아지는 volumetric god-rays, 마법 같은 황금 스파크, high-fantasy grandeur.
​Camera Movement: 그녀가 일어설 때는 static mid-shot tracking forward, 이후 갑옷 변신과 영웅적인 무릎 꿇는 포즈를 dynamic close-ups로 전환.
​Scene 3: Ready for Battle (00:18 – 00:30)
​Visual Elements: 정교한 별무늬 방패와 전사의 집중한 표정 클로즈업. 그녀는 방패에서 빛나는 황금 봉인/룬 원을 소환하고, 자신감 있게 앞으로 나아가며, 기둥에서 역동적으로 뛰어내려 전투 준비 자세로 우아하게 착지한다.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 반짝이는 황금빛 굴절광, 강렬하고 영웅적이며 긴장감 있는 분위기.
​Camera Movement: 방패 클로즈업, 표정, 그리고 dramatic slow-motion aerial spin 사이를 rapid cuts로 전환.
​Scene 4: The Divine Charge (00:31 – 00:36)
​Visual Elements: 전사가 빛나는 검을 앞으로 겨누고 광택이 나는 대리석 바닥을 가로질러 돌진한다. 그녀의 움직임마다 방패에서 마법 같은 황금 충격파와 빛의 고리가 퍼져 나온다.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 고에너지 액션, glowing light bursts, cinematic depth of field.
​Camera Movement: 그녀의 돌진보다 앞서 뒤로 물러나며 따라가는 fast tracking shot으로 속도와 힘을 강조.
​Scene 5: The Healer's Resurgence (00:37 – 00:49)
​Visual Elements: 다시 고요한 왕좌의 방으로 돌아와, 여성이 흰 드레스를 입은 채 왕좌에 다시 앉아 있다. 그녀가 팔걸이를 만지자 황금빛 마법 에너지와 떠다니는 룬 기하학 도형이 주변에 나타난다. 영상은 마지막에 그녀의 강렬한 갑옷 전사 모습으로 돌아가는 cross-fade의 한 장면으로 마무리된다.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 부드럽고 신비로우며 신성하고 사색적인 빛이 절대적인 힘의 아우라로 전환된다.
​Camera Movement: 앉아 있는 여성에게 gentle push-in을 적용하고, 강렬하고 상징적인 final portrait frame으로 끝낸다.

pt.content:
Divida seu trailer em cenas curtas, com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, 3–12s cada), e gere cada cena separadamente no Seedance 2.0; depois, monte o trailer completo no CapCut.

Para cada prompt de cena no Seedance, especifique explicitamente Visual Elements, Lighting & Atmosphere e Camera Movement para controlar o design do ambiente, o clima e o comportamento da tomada.

Use linguagem de establishing shot como “slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down” para obter aberturas épicas de world-building.

Para retratar a transformação de um personagem, descreva uma sequência de ação clara (stand up → golden light particles swirl → outfit transforms into armored suit) e peça “dynamic close-ups” durante a mudança.

Para o ritmo de ação, use “rapid cuts” entre sujeitos específicos (shield close-ups, facial expressions, movement beats) e inclua “dramatic slow-motion” para um momento heroico.

Para enfatizar a velocidade em uma investida, peça um “fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her” e adicione “cinematic depth of field” mais “glowing light bursts.”

Para um final poderoso, peça um “gentle push-in” que se resolva em um “iconic final portrait frame”, e use um cross-fade para fazer a transição entre formas (gown → armored warrior).

--- CONTINUAÇÃO DO THREAD ---
[Thread 1] Scene 1: The Celestial City (00:00 – 00:03)
​Visual Elements: Uma metrópole de fantasia expansiva e vasta, construída inteiramente em mármore branco e arquitetura dourada, com torres góticas imponentes, catedrais majestosas e pontes com vista para uma baía costeira calma sob um céu claro e nublado.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Luz do dia intensa, etérea, majestosa, escala grandiosa, establishing shot cinematográfico de fantasia épica.
​Camera Movement: Slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down at the magnificent kingdom.
​Scene 2: The Throne Room Transformation (00:04 – 00:17)
​Visual Elements: Uma vasta e ornamentada sala do trono em branco e dourado, com pilares enormes, janelas arqueadas de vitral e faixas de seda esvoaçantes. Uma jovem de cabelos loiros longos, inicialmente vestindo um vestido grego branco fluido, senta-se em um trono dourado intrincado e de encosto alto. Ela se levanta, e partículas mágicas de luz dourada giram ao redor dela, transformando sua roupa em uma elaborada armadura celestial de guerreira em branco e dourado, completa com um escudo estampado e uma espada larga brilhante.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: God-rays volumétricos atravessando as janelas altas, faíscas douradas mágicas, grandiosidade de alta fantasia.
​Camera Movement: Static mid-shot tracking forward as she stands, shifting to dynamic close-ups of her armor transformation and heroic kneeling pose.
​Scene 3: Ready for Battle (00:18 – 00:30)
​Visual Elements: Close-up on the intricate, star-patterned shield and the warrior's focused expression. She summons a glowing golden seal/runic circle from her shield, steps forward with confidence, and executes a dynamic leap off a pillar, landing gracefully in a battle-ready stance.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Shimmering golden light refractions, intense, heroic, and poised.
​Camera Movement: Rapid cuts between shield close-ups, facial expressions, and a dramatic slow-motion aerial spin.
​Scene 4: The Divine Charge (00:31 – 00:36)
​Visual Elements: The warrior points her glowing sword forward and charges across the polished marble floor. Magical golden shockwaves and light rings radiate from her shield with every movement.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: High-energy action, glowing light bursts, cinematic depth of field.
​Camera Movement: Fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her charge, emphasizing speed and power.
​Scene 5: The Healer's Resurgence (00:37 – 00:49)
​Visual Elements: Return to the serene throne room where the woman sits back down on the throne in her white gown. She touches the armrest, causing golden magical energy and floating runic geometries to materialize around her. The video culminates in a final cross-fade glimpse back to her fierce armored warrior form.
​Lighting & Atmosphere: Soft, mystical, divine, and reflective glow transitioning into an aura of absolute power.
​Camera Movement: Gentle push-in on the seated woman, ending with a powerful, iconic final portrait frame.

zh.content:
将你的预告片拆分成短小、带时间码的场景（例如每段 3–12 秒），并在 Seedance 2.0 中分别生成每个场景，然后在 CapCut 中将完整预告片剪辑拼接起来。

对于每个 Seedance 场景提示词，明确指定 Visual Elements、Lighting & Atmosphere 和 Camera Movement，以控制环境设计、氛围和镜头行为。

使用类似 “slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down” 这样的 establishing-shot 语言，来获得史诗级世界观开场。

要表现角色变身，请提示一个清晰的动作序列（stand up → golden light particles swirl → outfit transforms into armored suit），并在变化过程中要求 “dynamic close-ups”。

在动作节奏上，提示在特定主体之间进行 “rapid cuts” （shield close-ups、facial expressions、movement beats），并为英雄时刻加入 “dramatic slow-motion”。

为了强调冲刺时的速度感，提示一个 “fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her”，并加上 “cinematic depth of field” 和 “glowing light bursts”。

为了打造有力的结尾，提示一个 “gentle push-in”，最终落到 “iconic final portrait frame”，并使用 cross-fade 在不同形态之间过渡（gown → armored warrior）。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Scene 1: The Celestial City (00:00 – 00:03)
​Visual Elements: 一座宏伟、绵延不绝的奇幻大都会，完全由白色大理石与金色建筑构成，拥有高耸的哥特式尖塔、庄严的教堂，以及俯瞰宁静海湾的桥梁，天空明亮而多云。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 明亮日光、空灵、庄严、恢宏尺度、cinematic epic fantasy establishing shot。
​Camera Movement: Slow, sweeping wide establishing shot looking down at the magnificent kingdom.
​Scene 2: The Throne Room Transformation (00:04 – 00:17)
​Visual Elements: 一座宽阔华丽的白金色王座厅，拥有巨大的立柱、拱形彩绘玻璃窗和飘动的丝绸旗幡。一位留着长金发的年轻女子，最初身穿飘逸的白色希腊风长袍，坐在一张精致的高背金色王座上。她站起身，魔法般的金色光粒环绕四周，将她的服装变为一套华丽的、天体风格的白金色铠甲战士套装，配有纹样盾牌和发光的阔剑。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 体积光神圣光束从高窗洒入，魔法金色火花，高奇幻的恢宏气势。
​Camera Movement: Static mid-shot tracking forward as she stands, shifting to dynamic close-ups of her armor transformation and heroic kneeling pose.
​Scene 3: Ready for Battle (00:18 – 00:30)
​Visual Elements: 特写带有星形纹样的精致盾牌，以及战士专注的神情。她从盾牌中召唤出一个发光的金色印记/符文圆环，自信地向前迈步，并完成一次充满动感的从立柱跃下，在落地时优雅地摆出战斗准备姿势。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 闪烁的金色光线折射，强烈、英勇、蓄势待发。
​Camera Movement: Rapid cuts between shield close-ups, facial expressions, and a dramatic slow-motion aerial spin.
​Scene 4: The Divine Charge (00:31 – 00:36)
​Visual Elements: 战士将发光的剑指向前方，穿过抛光的大理石地面发起冲锋。每一次动作都会从她的盾牌中迸发出魔法般的金色冲击波与光环。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 高能动作、发光爆闪、cinematic depth of field。
​Camera Movement: Fast tracking shot moving backward ahead of her charge, emphasizing speed and power.
​Scene 5: The Healer's Resurgence (00:37 – 00:49)
​Visual Elements: 回到宁静的王座厅，女子重新坐回王座上，身着白色长袍。她触碰扶手，金色魔法能量与漂浮的符文几何体随之在周围显现。视频最终以一个 cross-fade 过渡，短暂回到她那位强悍的铠甲战士形态。
​Lighting & Atmosphere: 柔和、神秘、神圣、带有反思感的光辉，逐渐过渡为绝对力量的气场。
​Camera Movement: Gentle push-in on the seated woman, ending with a powerful, iconic final portrait frame.
